content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "PILOT FISH (program element 0603525N) is a U.S. Navy research-and-development program funded in the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Navy account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3b60902cb4acba07"}}, {"text": "The program is classified: its budget justification states that the details are classified per Executive Order 13526, Sec. 1.4(a), and are submitted annually to Congress in the classified budget justification book.", "citation": {"fact_id": "117341d8522db1bd"}}, {"text": "Because the justification is classified, no public description of the program's specific mission, projects, or deliverables is available in the unclassified budget exhibits.", "citation": {"fact_id": "02ae349a762a11c5"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The program's total funding rises from $982,324 thousand (about $982 million) in FY2025 to $1,218,486 thousand (about $1.22 billion) requested for FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "374b07d0a293f180"}}, {"text": "That is a year-over-year increase of $236,162 thousand (about $236 million) from FY2025 to FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3b4d40fe3362b5b0"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the program recorded actual spending of $877,003 thousand (about $877 million), so funding has grown steadily across the three years despite the classified nature of the work.", "citation": {"fact_id": "15545c196d0600c6"}}, {"text": "The entire FY2026 request of $1,218,486 thousand is discretionary funding; the program element carries no reconciliation (mandatory) request for FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "fab5407c5312658d"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Navy, with funding drawn from the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Navy appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "fab5407c5312658d"}}, {"text": "No external players, offices, or partners are named in the unclassified record because the program's justification is classified per Executive Order 13526.", "citation": {"fact_id": "117341d8522db1bd"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
